name: formula-analyst
description: Race analysis dashboard for every Grand Prix weekend since 2018, from practice and qualifying to the race: replay on the circuit map, timing, pace and tyre strategy, telemetry, a tyre-wear model and championship standings. Built with Python, FastF1, pandas, Plotly, scikit-learn and Streamlit.

paragraphs: A race analysis dashboard built on FastF1 timing data. It covers every Grand Prix weekend from 2018 to the latest 2026 round, from first practice to the race, and the championship around it.
features: Race: positions and gaps lap by lap, a timing screen for any lap, a replay on the track map, pace and tyre degradation, pit stops and undercuts, and two drivers' fastest laps compared channel by channel.
Strategy: a model trained on races since 2019 predicts how much time each tyre compound loses, and a simulator ranks one- and two-stop plans against the winner's.
Practice, qualifying and sprints: results, gaps to pole, long runs and sector times for every session of the weekend.
Championship: drivers' and teams' standings after any round, who can still win the title, and points through the season.
Weather, race control decisions, penalties and team radio for every session.
